summary: Reviewed 40 units (3.7.1-40). Word-level Sanskrit, case labels and sandhi are sound; the main defect is structural: ~32 tokens printed with '.' compounds were split into several word entries instead of one hyphenated w (hand edit). Content patches: 3 Hindi added-words removed (units 4, 6, 9), dharma/standing fixed (8, 15), dropped tu restored (19), supplied होता है removed (31, 32), vṛtta-anuvṛtta left untranslated (36), a gram tag (7), notes (3, 6, 26, 36). No 'thus'/'इस प्रकार' for iti, no Latin or brackets in Hindi, no unbalanced quotes. Confidences are honest (low on 8, 15, 20, 24, 29, 35, 36). No regrouping suggested.
